verdict.rationale: The pack mentions built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse agents and "model-native agents", but no item says any of them act on screenshots or offer a vision or computer-use mode. HyperAgent's page.ai uses natural-language commands with no stated vision mode. Screenshot output from scrape and fetch is a data format, not an action mode, so it does not count for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch to a vision or computer-use action mode that operates on screenshots for canvases and UIs the DOM path can't handle
